disposition_mapping.rationale: The council converged, after the maximalist's initial elimination proposal was withdrawn under pressure from finance_domain, emerging_economy and agentic_architect, on retaining assembly as a discrete, observable boundary: a meaningful share of exceptions are actually assembly failures (missing GRN, closed PO, blanket-PO draw-down) that must not be miscounted as matching exceptions in control reporting (KB-03). The function is redesigned as system-executed by default with no named human actor in the clean path, but with manual/semi-manual assembly as a first-class, equally-valid completion path (per emerging_economy, conceded by agentic_architect) rather than a bolted-on fallback, and with typed failure outputs so a human is told, not left to discover, when assembly cannot complete. KB-09's requirement that the invoice-GRN-PO evidence chain be reconstructable is preserved via explicit document-version provenance.

Quantity matching against GRN data is preserved (R-01, R-03) inside a single deterministic matching computation with price/terms matching, as near-unanimously agreed: the three-step split reflects legacy batch-era architecture, not a control requirement, since neither KB-09 nor KB-11 require separate procedural steps, only that the comparison function exist and be evidenced. Per finance_domain and accounting_standards, quantity variance remains a separately identifiable, separately routable output within the merged step rather than being commingled with price variance, since the two have distinct root causes (logistics vs. procurement/contract) and route to different resolvers.

Price and terms matching against PO data is preserved (R-02, R-04) in the same merged computation. Per accounting_standards' KB-09 point and the convergent finance_domain/accounting_standards gap-fill on KB-08, price/terms variance output must remain separately identifiable from quantity variance and must not silently absorb FX movement where PO and invoice currencies diverge; a distinct FX-variance output is added to prevent exchange differences being netted invisibly into price variance, a gap every council member's merge proposal initially shared.

Tolerance evaluation survives (R-05) as a deterministic lookup absorbed into the merged matching step, consistent with unanimous council agreement that classification against a pre-set policy is mechanical once the policy exists. The tolerance policy remains a required, versioned input (R-06), and per agentic_architect and accounting_standards every classification output records the specific policy version applied, preserving KB-06's consistency requirement and KB-03's cutoff discipline against mid-period policy changes. Policy authorship and review cadence remain a separately governed, human-owned artifact outside this step's execution, per hitl_designer's point that the real judgment sits in setting the bands, not applying them.

Exception investigation and resolution survives (R-10) but is restructured so that evidence-gathering and pattern-matching are agent-performed while the accept/correct/reject disposition remains a human decision-of-record by default. This resolves the council's sharpest live conflict in favour of hitl_designer, pragmatist, finance_domain, emerging_economy and accounting_standards against the maximalist's default-auto-resolution proposal: a confidence score is evidence toward a resolution, not a resolution (KB-04, KB-05), and a nontrivial share of exceptions have root causes outside the three documents that no pattern-matching closes. Agentic_architect's credential-scoping mechanism is adopted as the enforcement mechanism: the investigation/recommendation function's service credentials cannot write to the ledger regardless of confidence, so propose/never-dispose is a system-permission fact, not an instruction. A bounded, named, off-by-default auto-affirmation category is permitted only under an accountable policy owner who accepts residual risk, never as default architecture, satisfying KB-04's documented-basis requirement per-decision rather than by aggregate confidence threshold.

Match release approval survives (R-07), restructured into a routing gate: clean/in-tolerance matches auto-release as a logged system action (the judgment was already exercised once, in setting the tolerance policy, per hitl_designer and pragmatist), while exception-resolved and out-of-tolerance releases require a named AP supervisor who sees full variance detail, resolver rationale and identity rather than a bare approve/reject control (hitl_designer's anti-rubber-stamp point). Ordering is preserved: exception resolution (TGT-03) completes before release approval (TGT-04) is reached for that population, satisfying R-08. Actor separation (R-09) is maintained and strengthened: the resolver of record at TGT-03 is the AP analyst; release approval for the population requiring human review sits with the AP supervisor, a distinct actor, consistent with the council's unanimous insistence that separation of duties be real, not nominal. A circuit breaker invocable without an IT change request addresses emerging_economy's and finance_domain's connectivity/drift concerns.

Match control reporting is retained with a named human reviewer, rejecting the maximalist's proposal to dissolve it into ambient, unowned telemetry — a position six of seven council members converged against independently (KB-02's evidential-trail principle and KB-03's period-cutoff discipline require a record capable of supporting a period-end assertion, which presupposes an accountable party who can explain it; a log nobody is accountable for interpreting is raw data, not evidence of a functioning control). Production mechanics are automated (aggregation and drift-detection run continuously), but a named AP accountant / controls owner reviews flagged patterns on a defined cadence and holds authority over the TGT-04 kill switch, satisfying the coupling finance_domain identified between auto-release design and pattern-level oversight.

steps.actor: Automated assembly function (system-executed by default); AP analyst for manual/semi-manual assembly input and for assembly-failure resolution
steps.description: A deterministic retrieval-and-validation function resolves the invoice's PO and GRN references and assembles the match document set, with document versions, source system, retrieval timestamp and retrieval path (system-pulled or analyst-confirmed manual input) recorded as provenance. Manual or semi-manual assembly (e.g. analyst-keyed confirmation of a paper or late-posted GRN) is a first-class completion path, not a fallback, for deployments where live system connectivity or clean master data cannot be assumed. Incomplete or unresolvable document sets are not retried silently or dropped into an unowned queue; they are emitted as typed, named failure outputs (PO not found, PO closed, GRN pending, multiple partial GRNs requiring aggregation, unresolved PO reference) routed to an AP analyst for action. This step remains a discrete, observable boundary so that a failure can be diagnosed as an assembly problem rather than miscounted as a matching exception in downstream control reporting.
steps.name: Automated match dataset assembly
outputs: Assembled match document set (with document-version, source and retrieval-path provenance)
Typed assembly-failure output (PO not found, PO closed, GRN pending, multiple partial GRNs, unresolved reference)

steps.actor: Automated matching and tolerance-classification engine (system-executed; deterministic rules, no model inference)
steps.description: A deterministic rules engine, not an inferential or model-judgment function, compares the assembled document set line by line: invoiced quantity against received quantity, invoiced unit price/discount/tax against the purchase order, and, where PO and invoice are denominated or settled in different currencies, order-date rate against invoice/settlement-date rate. Quantity variance, price-and-terms variance and FX variance are emitted as separately identifiable, separately typed objects in a single pass, because they have different root causes (logistics, procurement/contract, currency movement) and route to different resolvers downstream; they are never commingled into one undifferentiated figure. The computed variances are then classified against a versioned tolerance policy table (clean, within tolerance, exception), with the specific policy version applied recorded on every classification output so that tolerance-band changes are visible and attributable rather than silently altering measured cost across a reporting boundary. Authorship and periodic review of the tolerance policy itself remains a separately governed, human-owned artifact outside this step's execution path; this step consumes that policy but does not set it.
steps.name: Automated three-way match execution
outputs: Match classification (clean, tolerance or exception) with tolerance-policy version and variance-type routing hint

steps.actor: AP analyst (resolution decision-of-record), supported by an investigation/recommendation function with no ledger-write authority
steps.description: An investigation function assembles an evidence packet for each exception-classified match: historical vendor/line patterns, correspondence, prior resolution precedents and a candidate-cause confidence score, plus, where a resolution-recommendation function is used, a proposed disposition with rationale. This output is strictly advisory: the proposing function's service credentials cannot write to the ledger or close the exception under any confidence score, so the propose/dispose boundary is enforced architecturally, not by instruction alone. A named AP analyst reviews the evidence packet and any recommendation and decides the disposition (accepted, corrected or rejected) as the resolver of record, because each disposition fixes a specific posted amount and liability treatment and therefore requires an accountable, documented basis; a pattern match or confidence score is evidence toward a resolution, not a resolution. A narrow, explicitly authorised, bounded low-materiality auto-affirmation category may exist as an off-by-default policy flag with a named accountable policy owner who accepts the residual risk and whose per-instance model reasoning is captured as the documented basis; it is not the default behaviour for the general exception population. Root causes that lie outside the three documents (vendor shipped against wrong PO, verbal price change never reflected on the PO, warehouse mis-keying) are routed to the human resolver as the default path regardless of pattern confidence, since no document re-pulling closes that loop.
steps.name: Exception investigation and resolution
outputs: Investigation evidence packet (candidate cause, confidence, supporting evidence, optional proposed disposition)
Resolved match (accepted, corrected or rejected) with resolver identity and documented rationale

steps.actor: Automated release gate (for clean/in-tolerance matches); AP supervisor (for exception-resolved and out-of-tolerance releases)
steps.description: A routing gate separates two populations. Clean and in-tolerance matches auto-release as a system action, logged as system-released with the match classification and tolerance-policy version attached as provenance, reflecting that the human judgment governing this population was already exercised once, when the tolerance policy was set. Exception-resolved and out-of-tolerance matches route to a named AP supervisor, distinct from the resolver at TGT-03, who reviews the full variance detail, the resolver's rationale and identity, and approves or declines release before posting; this gate is never a bare approve/reject control with no underlying context. The auto-release branch carries a circuit breaker, invocable by the named supervisor or the TGT-05 control reviewer without an IT change request, that trips auto-release to held-for-manual-review if drift (override rate, auto-release volume, classification pattern) exceeds a defined band, so degradation to manual approval is a standing, immediately available operating mode rather than a theoretical disaster-recovery procedure.
steps.name: Match release approval
outputs: Released match authorisation (system-released or supervisor-released, distinguished)

steps.actor: AP accountant / controls owner (named reviewer), supported by automated aggregation and drift-detection
steps.description: Automated aggregation computes match-rate, override-rate, assembly-failure-rate and auto-release-volume metrics on a defined cadence, with a drift-detection function flagging anomalous vendor or variance-type patterns as candidates for review. A named AP accountant / controls owner reviews these flagged patterns and the underlying control record on a defined cadence tied to the close calendar, holds authority to trip or reset the TGT-04 auto-release kill switch, and is accountable for interpreting drift, not merely for the record's existence. The control record distinguishes assembly failures from matching exceptions, and system-released from supervisor-released populations, so that it remains credible evidence supporting period-end payable balance and cutoff assertions rather than an unowned log.
steps.name: Match control reporting
outputs: Match-rate and override report, with drift flags
